test_title: PYST 5: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under which of the following conditions is a Tribal Advisory Council (TAC) established in a State?

options.text: If the State has any forest area
If there is at least one Scheduled Tribe

solution:
The correct answer is __**If there is at least one Scheduled Tribe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **Tribal Advisory Council (TAC)** is established in states as per the provisions of the **Fifth Schedule** of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• The purpose of the TAC is to advise on welfare and advancement matters related to Scheduled Tribes.
 
• As per the Constitution, TACs are mandatory in states that have Scheduled Areas and substantial tribal populations. *Hence, option 4 is correct.*
 
• The council consists of up to **20 members**, with **three-fourths** of them being representatives of Scheduled Tribes in the Legislative Assembly.
 
• The Governor of the state plays a significant role in establishing the TAC and can consult it for recommendations regarding Scheduled Tribes' welfare. *Hence, option 4 is the correct condition.*
 
• Options 1, 2, and 3 (tribal population exceeding 10% or 50%, or states having forest areas) are not relevant as the Constitution explicitly mentions the presence of Scheduled Tribes as the deciding factor. *Hence, these options are incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tribal Advisory Council (TAC):**

 
 
• TAC is constituted under the **Fifth Schedule** of the Constitution to provide advice on matters concerning the welfare and development of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• It provides recommendations related to the **implementation of tribal welfare programs**, protection of tribal rights, and socio-economic development.
 
 
 
• **Fifth Schedule of the Constitution:**
 
 
• The Fifth Schedule applies to states with **Scheduled Areas** and focuses on the protection and development of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• It empowers the **Governor** to regulate the transfer of land in Scheduled Areas and ensure that tribal interests are safeguarded.
 
• The Governor can also make regulations to prohibit or restrict the alienation of tribal land and consult the TAC for advice.
 
 
 
• **Scheduled Areas:**
 
 
• Scheduled Areas are regions identified under the Constitution where tribal populations are predominant and need special attention for development and welfare.
 
• These areas are declared by the President of India and are governed under special provisions to protect tribal rights and culture.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of the Governor:**

 
 
• The Governor of a state with Scheduled Areas has the authority to establish a Tribal Advisory Council and consult it for advice.
 
• The Governor can also modify or amend laws applicable to Scheduled Areas to protect tribal interests.
 
 
 
• **States with Scheduled Areas:**
 
 
• Examples include **Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Andhra Pradesh**, among others.
 
• These states have substantial tribal populations and require special provisions for tribal welfare.
